{{dablink|This page concerns the ''River of Souls'' geographic feature. For the deleted sequence of {{amol}} published in ''Unfettered'', see {{ros}}.}}

'''Angarai'la''', the '''River of Souls''', is a stream in [[Shara]].{{ref/book|ros}} ''Angarai'la'' flows through a rift valley called [[Abyrward]].

==Rai'lair==
''[[Rai'lair]]'', the [[Hearttomb]], is an ancient cave that is the source of the River of Souls. Inside is the ancient hiding place of the cup-shaped half of [[Sakarnen]],{{ref/book|twotc|Sakarnen}} which was protected by an adult [[Jumara (Shadowspawn)|Jumara]] and the head of a [[Nym]].

While the remnant of the Nym survived, the cave was overgrown with foliage.{{ref/book|ros}} Following the destruction of the Nym, this may no longer be the case.

==The Coming of The Wyld==
In {{ne|1000}} [[Demandred]], called Bao, came to walk the path of ''Angarai'la''. Inside ''Rai'lair'' Demandred defeated an adult [[Jumara (Shadowspawn)|Jumara]] that had taken up residence inside the cave. He then killed what remained of the [[Nym]] and claimed the piece of Sakarnen that had been hidden there. He returned to the Sharan people at sunset of the third day, fulfilling one of the last prophesies of The Wyld.

== Parallels ==
* ''[[Rai'lair]]'', a secretive cave containing many corpses and a ferocious beast, and being the site of a major antagonist gaining an important item, likely refers to the English word 'lair' meaning 'a place where a wild animal, especially a fierce or dangerous one, lives;' 'a burial plot in a graveyard;' and 'a secret or private place in which a person, especially a criminal or enemy, takes refuge.'
